label: Plant context
description: Plant species, genus, crop, tissue, or host context recorded for manual review.

label: Target trait or metabolite
description: Exact trait, sugar, metabolite, or product identity recorded before downstream route discussion.

label: Candidate pathway
description: Pathway name or pathway family recorded as evidence context, not as a confirmed route.

label: Candidate gene or enzyme
description: Gene, enzyme, transporter, or regulatory candidate recorded with source/provenance context.

label: Tissue context
description: Tissue, organ, or expression compartment context for manual evidence review.

label: Evidence context
description: Direct or adjacent literature/case/component evidence needed before route generation can be discussed.

label: Target product
description: Protein or product identity recorded as documentation context.

label: Gene or CDS source
description: Gene or CDS provenance recorded for traceability review.
